title: Adopter Momentum Framework — SDK/Docs/Quickstart Growth Playbook
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a repeatable 'Adopter Momentum Framework' to accelerate SDK, docs, and quickstart adoption. The framework combines cohort-based experiments, a momentum scorecard (onboarding time, first successful call, retention after 7 days, and activation funnel conversion), and playbook artifacts (email templates, onboarding checklists, sample apps). This ticket scopes the playbook MVP, initial metrics, tooling requirements, and rollout plan for an early adopter cohort of platform partners.
acceptance_criteria: A documented momentum scorecard with definitions for each metric (onboarding_time, first_success_call, 7d_retention, funnel_conversion)
Three repeatable onboarding micro-journeys (SDK, docs-guided, quickstart sample app) published in the DevX repo with templates
Instrumentation in Console to surface cohort-level metrics for at least two partner cohorts
A runbook for 2-week cohort experiments with success thresholds and rollback criteria
Playbook reviewed and approved by Eng and Design with at least one pilot completed and learnings captured

2026-03-05: Design pushed low-fidelity onboarding checklists for SDK and quickstart flows; DES-404 created for visual polish and accessibility review.

risks_mitigation: Risk: Instrumentation delays could push pilot. Mitigation: fallback to sampled telemetry + manual verification for initial cohort.
Risk: Playbook too prescriptive for some partners. Mitigation: include 'light' and 'full' paths and a decision checklist.
Risk: Conflicting priorities with Dedicated rollout. Mitigation: block time in eng cycle and label tasks as 'cohort-pilot' for prioritization.
